text:
Maria Chen: FYI Atlantech usage plunged ~40% in the last 48h; renewal in 6 weeks. looks correlated with a security approval flow their infra team toggled.
Devon Lee: ugh. is it an outage or org change?
Maria Chen: not an outage — healthchecks ok. token counts and session starts dropped. quick query I ran:
```sql
SELECT day, sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE account_id = 'acct_atlantech' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 7;
```
Ashish Patel: ping exec sponsor and procurement. they asked about cost last week; possible competitor trial.
Maria Chen: looped Lucy (advocate) and Patrick (eng handoff). Lucy, can you lead outreach with a checklist? confirm admin churn and request their evaluation criteria.
Lucy Ramos: on it. scheduling 15m with new platform lead tomorrow. prep: check SSO keys, blocked endpoints, whether they tried our dedicated trial.
Patrick O'Neill: if they want dedicated capacity trial propose 2-week sandbox with elevated observability. I can prep config + runbook. :thumbsup:
Devon Lee: flag renewal ops — mark as "at-risk: stakeholder change" and start procurement continuity playbook.
ops-bot: Alert "usage-drop" triggered for acct_atlantech at 1729450890. Notifying: customer-success, sales.
Ashish Patel: capture procurement timeline and decision owners after the call, and any competitor names.
Maria Chen: agreed. Lucy will add notes. if they raise model parity concerns route to product for quick compare doc. thanks everyone.
